title: Knowledge context policy (knowledge-policy.yaml)
description: Which fields of a knowledge item each role may see, and how old an item may get before it is called stale (T68/T71). A file rather than code because these are project decisions — one team's 'devops does not need the body of an auth requirement' is another team's obstruction — and a decision that can only be changed by editing TypeScript is one nobody outside the repo can make. Absent entirely is a valid state: the built-in defaults are permissive, and the check says so rather than failing.

roles.description: Per-role overrides. A role absent here gets `defaults`.

by_kind.description: Per-kind overrides. A db-schema goes stale faster than a domain term: the code moves under it.

sensitive.description: What this role gets for an item flagged `sensitive`. full = everything. redacted = it exists, with its title and status, but not its body, payload or sources. hidden = not returned at all. An item's own owner always gets `full` regardless — a rule that hid a role's own work from it would be a bug, not a policy.

hide_fields.description: Fields removed from every item this role retrieves, sensitive or not. `body`, `sources`, `relations`, or `payload.<key>`.
